newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Daewoo wins $200 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Daewoo wins $200 mln China deal.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp, a trading and construction unit of the Daewoo Group, said on Monday it had won a $200 million contract from Beijing Galilee Real Estate Co to build a trade centre in central Beijing.
Construction will start in early 1997 with completion scheduled for 2000, a Daewoo statement said.
The trade centre will comprise a 34- and a 24-storey office building on a four-storey podium and a separate 14-storey apartment building, it said.
Beijing Galilee is a subsidiary of Hong Kong-based Galilee International Holdings Ltd, it added.
